verification_policy: Direct research with cross-source classification and acquisition review. Preserve source conflicts and do not infer Ultimate Finish requirements without explicit evidence.
research_scope: Chaotic Time Impact — Ki Blast Ultimate.

verification_audit.method: Cross-checked dedicated Xenoverse 2 skill documentation with the current PQ184 reward data and current PQ guide.
verification_audit.classification_finding: Current Xenoverse 2 documentation identifies Chaotic Time Impact as a Ki Blast Ultimate used by Golden Frieza (Ultra Supervillain), costing 600 Ki and producing a 27-hit one-handed beam after a stun effect.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: PQ184 — The Invincible Duo is independently documented as the acquisition quest. Madreag's current datamined reward record places the skill in the Ultimate Finish bonus slot at 50%.
verification_audit.ultimate_finish_policy: Recorded as true because the current datamined PQ184 reward record explicitly identifies Chaotic Time Impact as an Ultimate Finish bonus-slot reward.
verification_audit.cac_policy: Usability by CaC is recorded as null because the reviewed sources identify Golden Frieza (Ultra Supervillain) as the notable user but do not provide sufficient direct evidence to assert Future Warrior usability.
verification_audit.damage_policy: No fixed canonical damage value is recorded because the reviewed evidence describes Power of Time scaling rather than a stable database-ready damage value.

records.name: Chaotic Time Impact
records.skill_description: Stop the opponent with an unblockable ki-based time bubble, then unleash a powerful one-handed Ki wave. Accumulated Power of Time increases the wave's power.
records.mechanics_notes: The skill cages the opponent in a time bubble before gathering gold and purple energy and firing a one-handed beam. Power of Time accumulated through related Future Saga Chapter 3 skills can increase the attack's output; firing the Ki wave resets the accumulated Power of Time.
